## Quality Checklist

- [ ] Subtitle file is saved in `.ass` format with UTF-8 encoding.
- [ ] Translation follows Latin American Spanish guidelines (adaptive, natural, uncensored).
- [ ] File naming matches the project convention: `ANI][<Title>_<Episode>.ass`.
- [ ] Timings and styles have been tested and verified.
